standard_prerequisites.name: Topology of Proj
standard_prerequisites.use: Homeomorphisms D_+(g) = Spec(S_(g)) and the standard-open basis.

standard_prerequisites.name: Zariski topology of affines
standard_prerequisites.use: Invertibility of nonvanishing elements and the covering criterion in S_(f).

core_obligations: For D_+(g) inside D_+(f): invertibility of f in S_g and of f^{deg(g)}/g^{deg(f)} in S_(g); a homogeneous relation g^e = a f; canonical S-algebra and S_0-algebra maps on localizations and degree-zero parts.
The degree-zero maps identify S_(g) and M_(g) as principal localizations of S_(f) and M_(f); the prime correspondences form a commutative diagram of topological spaces with open-immersion verticals.
Any covering of D_+(f) refines to a finite standard covering; D_+(f) sits in a union of D_+(g_i) exactly when the fractions g_i^{deg(f)}/f^{deg(g_i)} generate the unit ideal in S_(f).
proof_roadmap: Derive invertibility from the affine Zariski topology, extract the homogeneous multiplier a, define the fraction maps, read off the principal localizations, then quote quasi-compactness and the covering criterion.
difficulty_reason: Localization algebra with explicit homogeneous fraction formulas and a topological compatibility diagram; fully displayed.
